request.subject: UNIT:DWARF:CATAPULT

layers.text: Add only one thing: one small round bright signal-green lamp, colour #2bd94a with a white #e8ffe8 glint, about three pixels wide, set in a little copper ring on the side of the iron carriage. Do not change anything else: keep the cannon barrel, the copper boiler and its steam, the two dwarf gunners, the wheels, the shapes, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
